issues.title: Ingest Howard County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $11,985,488 across 32 funds. The largest: County General ($3,579,401), Road ($3,476,112), Jail ($1,462,734). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
